key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide nozzle speed and spray-distance selection to target coating geometry and maximize water repellency.
method: Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle traverse speed and both roughness and thickness, plus parabolic relationships between spray distance and both roughness and contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical optima, parameter ranges, or prediction errors, limiting direct process implementation.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
